Game Overview

In Supermarket Simulator Dream Store, the core idea is straightforward: transform your small shop into a bustling retail paradise. Design and decorate to captivate customers, hire and train the perfect team, and cleverly manage orders and discounts. Watch as your supermarket flourishes with each new day and profitably scales up in this engaging management challenge.

How to Play

Supermarket Simulator Dream Store keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Transform your small shop into a bustling retail paradise!
